subject: Fastest air freight option: DUS to MEX
body:
Hi,

Could you quote the fastest air freight option from DUS to MEX (Mexico City, MX) and confirm the transit time? Please include the all-in price in EUR.

We’ll deliver to DUS ourselves. The shipment is ready on 2026-11-29: 1 piece of printed marketing material, 176 kg gross, 1.26 cbm.

Please include cargo insurance in the all-in price, on the terms of our frame agreement: goods value 22000 EUR, insured at 110 % of that value, premium rate 0.40 %.

Sara
Lindqvist Medtech

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting a new air freight quote for a specific shipment, including transit time and an all-in price.
